15382.d: Lair of Tarn Razorlor, also called Tarn's Lair, is a complex dungeon full of undead located in south-western Morytania.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The entrance to Tarn's Lair is at the northern end of the ground level of the Abandoned Mine.
• The fastest way to reach the end of Tarn's Lair is with a ring of slaying, which can be purchased from a Slayer Master or crafted by the player. This teleport allows the player to skip the entire dungeon.
• Drakan's medallion will teleport players to Burgh de Rott, where a shortcut over a fence to the west leads to the mine.
• Taking the shortcut under the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis and travelling on the swamp boat brings players close to Mort'ton. This shortcut is unlocked as a reward from the Burgh De Rott Ramble minigame.

gt.heading: Route
gt.text:
The player starts out on the lowest level, where the banker is to the north-east. Follow the dotted green line on the map to the right. To get there:
• After entering the lair from the Abandoned Mine, go east past the floor traps, wall trap on the north wall, and monsters to the end of the passage.
• Head north, turn east, then follow the path heading north again. There are two wall traps to disarm (by "searching" them via a right-click option): the southern one on the western wall, and the northern one on the eastern wall.

Odovacar is at the end of the corridor. This is the last place to restock or heal prior to moving to Tarn Razorlor (though there are a few safe places to rest along the way).
• From the banker, go north through the passageway.
• Follow the U-shaped hall all the way to the end, past floor traps, wall traps, and monsters. Take the western doorway.
• In the square room with a single giant skeleton in it, go through the passage to the north.
• In the following room, go through another passage to the west.
• You will now be in a hallway that looks like an inverted T. Take the passage to the north, avoiding the wall traps on both sides of the wall, and go through the doorway on the west side.

This puts you in a room with pillars that you must jump across and a log trap you must disable. There are no monsters here, so use this room to heal if necessary.
• Make your way to the west side of the room using the southern pillars and deactivate the log swing trap by searching the button on the floor. The trap will eventually reset, so move quickly.
• Use the second column of pillars from the west to go north.
• Follow the path to the east, past wall traps on the southern and northern walls, and you will end up in a room with four walls that shoot out periodically. Time your moves to avoid being knocked into the hole or use surge twice to pass through it. Be careful to surge at the westernmost tile (while still facing the right direction) or you risk surging right into the pillar-pusher.
• Take the passageway through the eastern wall.

There are more pillars to jump over; the correct route zigzags across the room from the north-west to the south-east. You will be attacked by two level 79 skeleton Mages as you cross the room.

Once across, go down the stairs into an empty room, which leads to the final rooms to the north with Tarn Razorlor and his terror dogs. This is where the ring of slaying's teleport leaves players, and can be used to prepare for combat.

At the northern end of the next room is the entrance to Tarn's living quarters, where Tarn's diary sits on a table. If players bring a salve amulet, it can be upgraded to a salve amulet (e) by using the amulet with the diary.

15383.d: Lair of Tarn Razorlor (miniquest) is a miniquest in which the player's objective is to kill Tarn Razorlor and retrieve his diary, allowing them to enchant the salve amulet.

gt.heading: Getting to Tarn Razorlor
gt.text:
The ring of slaying can teleport you directly to Tarn's lair, if you've unlocked it. This is the fastest and easiest method, as it allows the player to completely skip navigating the dungeon.

The entrance to Tarn's Lair is at the northern end of the top level of the Abandoned Mine.
• Drakan's medallion will teleport players to Burgh de Rott, where a shortcut over a fence to the west leads to the mine.
• Taking the shortcut under the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis and travelling on the Swamp Boat brings players close to Mort'ton.

For a guide to the correct path through the dungeon, see Lair of Tarn Razorlor (dungeon)#Route.
